text.en: Includes Visual Curator 0.2.13, Codex Subscription 0.2.3 and Style Prompt 0.2.0 while preserving saved profile data and activation choices.
text.zh-CN: 随附视觉策展 0.2.13、Codex 订阅 0.2.3、风格提示词 0.2.0，保留已有 profile 数据和启用选择。

text.en: Configured Codex image models can generate original images and previews through the native model API for canvas workflows.
text.zh-CN: 已配置的 Codex 图片模型可通过原生模型接口供画布调用，分别保留生成原图和预览附件。

text.en: Style Prompt provides a persistent node canvas for reference analysis, bilingual prompts and image-generation branches, with autosave, history and import/export.
text.zh-CN: 风格提示词新增持久化节点画布，连接参考分析、双语提示词及生图分支，支持自动保存、历史和导入导出。

text.en: Reference analysis automatically organizes and saves datasets, with consistent positive/negative roles, rule statistics and compact version history.
text.zh-CN: 参考分析自动整理并保存数据集，统一正反例角色与规则统计，紧凑展示数据集版本历史。
